# Profile: navigation

> Offline maps and turn-by-turn navigation from your own GPS, with no network

**Stage:** post-1.0

## What it installs

gpsd and its clients to read the GPS receiver, and Navit, an offline turn-by-turn navigator with spoken directions through espeak-ng, with `maptool`, the program that converts OpenStreetMap data into Navit's map format.

**Disk footprint:** Navit, espeak-ng and gpsd from the archive (size not yet measured). With maps, add the regions you choose, plus Navit's converted copy of each (size not yet measured); a single US state's download ranges from tens of megabytes to about 1.3 GB for California.

## Why these belong together

A navigator is only useful with a position and a map, and offline it needs both already on the machine. Navit without gpsd does not know where you are, and gpsd alone is a position with nothing to show it on. The same install serves daily driving and an EMCOMM deployment with the phone network down.

## Packages (3)

[`gpsd`](../packages/gpsd.md), [`gpsd-clients`](../packages/gpsd-clients.md), [`navit`](../packages/navit.md)

## What it deliberately excludes

The maps themselves, for now: `osm-regions` (the OpenStreetMap regions you choose, downloaded from Geofabrik and verified) and `osm-navit` (those regions converted for Navit, and the configuration the `navit-offline` launcher opens) are catalog units whose install methods the engine does not perform yet, so they are not members until it does. Hiking and topographic maps, tile servers and other map readers are the next piece of this work. Navit's GTK interface (`navit-gui-gtk`) is left out in favour of the internal one, which suits a touch screen and a small panel. Grid-square readouts belong to the station and dashboard tools.

## What you configure by hand afterward

A GPS receiver must be attached and seen by gpsd; `xgps`, from gpsd-clients, shows whether it has a fix. Navit needs maps before it shows anything: until `osm-regions` and `osm-navit` join this profile, plain `navit` runs Debian's own configuration and the `navit-offline` launcher has no configuration to open. The map regions will come from station config, set with Geofabrik's region paths, for example `hammunition station set --map-regions north-america/us/vermont,north-america/us/new-hampshire`.
